cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: Good morning. Thanks for coming in to see us here at the agency, Joe.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: I'm one of the agency representatives, and my name's Sally Baker.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: Hi Sally. I think we spoke on the phone, didn't we?

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: That's right, we did. So thank you for sending in your CV.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: We've had quite a careful look at it and I think we have two jobs that might be suitable

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: for you.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: The first one is in a company based in North London.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: They're looking for an administrative assistant.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: They're called Home Solutions and they design and make furniture.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: Oh, I don't know much about that, but it sounds interesting.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: Yes, well as I said, they want someone in their office, and looking at your past

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: experience it does look as if you fit quite a few of the requirements.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: So on your CV it appears you've done some data entry?

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: So that's one skill they want.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: Then they expect the person they appoint to attend meetings and take notes there ...

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: And you'd need to be able to cope with general admin.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: Filling, and keeping records and so on? That should be OK.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: And in my last job I also had to manage the diary.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: Excellent. That's something they want here too.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: I'd suggest you add it to your CV – I don't think you mentioned that, did you?

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: So as far as the requirements go, they want good computer skills, of course, and they

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: particularly mention spreadsheets.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: And interpersonal skills – which would be something they'd check with your references.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: Then they mention that they want someone who is careful and takes care with details –

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: just looking at your CV, I'd say you're probably alright there.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: I think so, yes. Do they want any special experience?

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: I think they wanted some experience of teleconferencing.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: let's see, yes, good. In fact they're only asking for at least one year, so that's great.

cues.speaker: LY
cues.text: So is that something that might interest you?

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: It is, yes.

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: The only thing is, you said they were in North London so it would be quite a long commute

cues.speaker: OE
cues.text: for me.
